components.name: Primary Scan Button
components.description: Primary action button triggering optical metrology calibration.
components.css: .dmd-btn-primary { background: #f59e0b; color: #0c0e12; font-family: 'Inconsolata', monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3); } .dmd-btn-primary:hover { background: #d97706; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.45); }

components.name: Vermilion Wax Seal
components.description: Official verification seal applied to Class 0 certified specimens.
components.css: .dmd-wax-seal { width: 80px; height: 80px; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #dc2626 0%, #991b1b 65%, #7f1d1d 100%); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.4), inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border: 1px solid rgba(254, 202, 202, 0.4); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transform: rotate(4deg); text-align: center; } .dmd-wax-seal .sub { font-family: 'Inconsolata', monospace; font-size: 0.45rem; color: #fee2e2; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .dmd-wax-seal .grade { font-family: 'Marcellus', serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #fef2f2; font-weight: bold; margin: 2px 0; } .dmd-wax-seal .status { font-family: 'Inconsolata', monospace; font-size: 0.45rem; color: #fecaca; letter-spacing: 0.15em; }

narrative.northStar: The National Directorate for Dosa Circularity
narrative.overview: A fusion of ancient Indian sacred radial geometry and the exacting precision of an unyielding national standards and calibration bureau. Built with seasoned cast-iron materiality, rice-flour chalk geometry lines, warm golden ghee roast highlights, and deadpan academic wit.
keyCharacteristics: Authentic seasoned cast-iron dark canvas (#0c0e12) replacing generic cyberpunk themes
Concentric polar reticle geometry with 360-degree ticks and Kolam corner alignment brackets
Academic typography hierarchy: Marcellus (display), Albert Sans (body), Inconsolata (telemetry)

rules.name: The Tawa Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text never uses gradient fills. Emphasis is achieved strictly through scale, weight, and the crisp contrast between chalk ivory and deep seasoned iron.

rules.name: The Single World Rule
rules.body: All UI elements, from navigation to the results report, speak the single vocabulary of the National Metrology Directorate.

dos: Do maintain the deadpan academic research tone throughout all UI copy and metrics
Do use Marcellus for display titles and Inconsolata for coordinates and telemetry
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion across radar sweeps and animations
donts: Don't use text gradients, glowing neon cyber cards, or generic SaaS marketing eyebrows
Don't use generic stock sans-serif fonts for numerical coordinates or headings
Don't upload user photos to remote servers; maintain pure browser-based client-side evaluation
